label_rule: A request/response row gets label C (a CWE) only if its (app, method, path, param) is listed below with C in 'vuln', and the payload sent was a C payload. A C payload sent to a listed parameter where C is not in 'vuln' (or to a 'safe' endpoint) is labelled 'safe'. Classes in 'unknown' and endpoints in 'exclude' are dropped. Requests to endpoints not listed here are dropped, never guessed.
